svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two rails 860 mm (front and back) and two rails 305 mm (sides).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The front and back rails fit between the post tops; the side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rails fit between the front and rear posts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hold each with inside corner brackets under the rail end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (front and back rails) or on the inner face (side rails):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M5 x 10 screws into drop-in T-nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All rail tops flush with the post tops, 570 mm above the deck.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide T-nuts into the top slots for the canopy screws before

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: closing the frame: 4 per long rail, 2 per side rail.
